name: chrome-eye
description: Chrome Eye — agent-driven browser control extension for DSH

scripts.prepare: node -e "\nconst fs=require('fs');const p=require('path');const nm=p.join(__dirname,'node_modules');const ld=p.join(nm,'@local');if(!fs.existsSync(ld))fs.mkdirSync(ld,{recursive:true});fs.readdirSync(p.join(__dirname,'plugins')).filter(f=>{const pp=p.join(__dirname,'plugins',f);return fs.statSync(pp).isDirectory();}).forEach(plugin=>{const lk=p.join(ld,plugin);const tg=p.join(__dirname,'plugins',plugin);try{fs.unlinkSync(lk);}catch(e){}fs.symlinkSync(tg,lk,'dir');console.log('  @local/'+plugin);});console.log('chrome-eye: prepared',fs.readdirSync(p.join(__dirname,'plugins')).filter(f=>fs.statSync(p.join(__dirname,'plugins',f)).isDirectory()).length,'plugins');\n"
